set system host-name CE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interface ge-0/0/0.explanation: This command sets configuration parameters for a specified network interface, such as IP address, MTU, or administrative status, in Junos OS.

unit 0 10.1.1.1/29.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set interface lo0.explanation: This command sets configuration parameters for a specified network interface, such as IP address, MTU, or administrative status, in Junos OS.

family inet address 3.3.3.3/32.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses and subnet masks for loop back interfaces.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: autonomous-system
parameters.explanation: Autonomy system number for equipment, used for route agreements such as BGP.

set routing-options rib all neighbors 10.explanation: This command configures all Routing Information Bases (RIBs) to accept routes from specified neighbors identified by `[parameter1]`.

peer-as 100.explanation: Configure the self-government system number of neighbours in the RIB.

set protocols bgp neighbor 10.1.1.2.explanation: Configures a BGP neighbor with the specified IP address or interface (`[parameter1]`) for establishing a BGP peering session.

peer-as 100.explanation: Configure BGP neighbours and their self-government systems.

export route-map import-route.explanation: Configure the export route map of the BGP peer group.

parameters.name: route-map
parameters.explanation: The name of the exit route map.

import route-map export-route.explanation: Configure the export and entrance route map of the BGP peer group.

set route-object create ro_3_3_3_0/32.explanation: The command `set route-object create [parameter1]` in Junos creates a new route object with the specified parameters for routing policy or configuration purposes.

route 3.3.3.3/32.explanation: Creates a router and specifies a router.

parameters.name: route
parameters.explanation: The IP address of the route and the subnet mask.
